summary.en: Enclose developing embryos

detail.en:
Each jelly coat surrounds an embryo, a young animal developing inside the egg. Only a small part of the egg group is shown. [S2]

The eggs are enlarged for a clear view. Their number here does not tell us how many eggs a frog lays. [S22]
detail.zh:
每个胶质包被围着一个胚胎，也就是在卵内发育的幼体。这里仅画了卵团的一小部分。[S2]

蛙卵放大后更容易看清。图里的数量不表示青蛙一次产卵的数量。[S22]

summary.en: Swims by moving its tail

detail.en:
A rounded body joins a tapering tail with a thin membrane. This swimming tadpole has no visible legs or feathery outer gills. [S2, S3]

A tadpole is a young frog. Some frogs instead develop inside their eggs and hatch as froglets. The tray shows a common pond-frog pathway. [S3, S5, S22]
detail.zh:
圆圆的身体连着逐渐变细的尾巴，尾巴上有薄膜。这只游泳的蝌蚪还看不到腿，也没有羽毛状的外鳃。[S2, S3]

蝌蚪是青蛙的幼体。有些蛙在卵内发育，孵出时已是幼蛙。展台上展示的是常见的池塘型发育路线。[S3, S5, S22]

summary.en: Grows hind legs beside the tail

detail.en:
Two hind legs are visible beside the tail. The front legs have not yet appeared. [S2, S3]

Each hind foot has five toes. This view shows a point in the tadpole's growth, rather than an exact age. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
尾巴两旁各有一条后腿，前肢还没有显现。[S2, S3]

每只后足有五趾。这个视图展示蝌蚪成长中的一个样子，没有表示确切的年龄。[S20, S22]

summary.en: Moves with limbs as its tail shrinks
summary.zh: 四肢出现，尾巴逐渐缩短

detail.en:
The froglet has a frog-shaped body and four limbs. A short tail is still attached. During metamorphosis, the body remodels and absorbs the tail tissues. The tail does not break off. [S2, S4]

Each front foot has four fingers and each hind foot has five toes. The tail length helps show the change in shape; it does not give the froglet's exact age. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
幼蛙已有蛙形的身体和四肢，身后仍连着一段短尾。变态发育时，身体改变并吸收尾部组织，尾巴不会断掉。[S2, S4]

每只前足有四指，每只后足有五趾。尾巴的长度帮助我们观察形态变化，不能用来判断幼蛙的确切年龄。[S20, S22]

summary.en: Has four limbs and no tadpole tail
summary.zh: 有四肢，已没有蝌蚪的尾巴

detail.en:
The adult frog has a broad head, short front limbs and folded hind limbs. It has no tadpole tail. Each front foot has four fingers and each hind foot has five toes. [S2, S20]

This is a general frog model. Singapore has several frog species. The link to eggs shows reproduction and a new generation. [S12, S15, S22]
detail.zh:
成蛙的头宽，前肢短，后肢屈曲，已经没有蝌蚪的尾巴。每只前足有四指，每只后足有五趾。[S2, S20]

这是通用的青蛙模型。新加坡有多个蛙种。通向卵的连接表示繁殖，开始新一代。[S12, S15, S22]

summary.en: Encloses the yolk and egg white

detail.en:
The hard shell encloses the egg white, yolk and other structures. Most of the shell stays in place when you open the model window. [S6, S7]

The cutaway shell lets you see inside. Its thickness and size have been chosen for a clear view. [S22]
detail.zh:
坚硬的蛋壳包住卵白、卵黄等结构。打开模型壳窗后，其余蛋壳仍留在原位。[S6, S7]

切开的蛋壳让我们看见内部。壳的厚度和大小经过调整，方便观察。[S22]

summary.en: Moves aside to reveal the egg contents

detail.en:
Open the window to move this shell piece aside and see inside the egg. Close it to make the shell whole again. [S22]

The neat cut is made for the model. A hatching chick opens the shell and comes out through the broken shell. [S6, S22]
detail.zh:
打开壳窗，这片壳会移到一旁，露出卵的内部。关窗后，蛋壳又合成完整形状。[S22]

整齐的切口是为模型设置的。真实的雏鸡孵出时会破壳，再从破开的蛋壳出来。[S6, S22]

summary.en: Feeds the developing embryo
summary.zh: 给发育中的胚胎提供营养

detail.en:
The yolk supplies food for the developing embryo. Look for the rounded yolk inside the egg. [S6, S7]

The embryo is drawn beside the yolk's surface. The yolk itself is not a small chick hidden at its centre. [S6, S22]
detail.zh:
卵黄给发育中的胚胎提供营养。找一找卵内圆圆的卵黄。[S6, S7]

模型把胚胎画在卵黄表面旁。卵黄本身不是小鸡，中心也没有藏着一只缩小的雏鸡。[S6, S22]

summary.en: Surrounds the yolk with water and protein
summary.zh: 围着卵黄，含水分和蛋白质

detail.en:
Egg white, also called albumen, surrounds the yolk. It contains water and protein. It is separate from both the yolk and the embryo. [S7]

The pale, see-through shape shows where egg white lies. The model leaves out the shell membranes, air cell and the strands that hold the yolk in place. [S7, S22]
detail.zh:
卵白围在卵黄外面，含有水分和蛋白质。它与卵黄、胚胎是不同的结构。[S7]

浅色透明部分表示卵白的位置。模型没有画出壳膜、气室，以及固定卵黄的系带。[S7, S22]

summary.en: Develops into the chick inside the egg

detail.en:
The small, curved shape beside the yolk represents a developing chick in a fertilised egg. The simple outline does not show an exact incubation age. [S6, S22]

Open the shell window and choose the fertilised example to see it. Closing the window covers it. In the unfertilised example, no chick develops; warmth cannot fertilise an egg. [S6, S9, S22]
detail.zh:
卵黄旁弯曲的小轮廓，表示受精卵内发育中的小鸡。这个简化形状没有表示确切的孵化日龄。[S6, S22]

打开壳窗、选择受精的例子，就能看见胚胎；关窗会把它遮住。未受精的卵无法发育出雏鸡，保温也不能使卵受精。[S6, S9, S22]

summary.en: Grows from a young bird into an adult

detail.en:
The chick has a short beak, a round body covered in down, two wings and two feet. It grows into an adult chicken without a pupa stage. [S6, S9]

Compare its proportions with the hen. The chick has short tail feathers and simplified down. Its shape differs from a smaller copy of the adult. [S22]
detail.zh:
雏鸡有短喙、覆盖绒羽的圆身体、两只翅和两只足。它逐渐长成成鸡，不经过蛹期。[S6, S9]

和母鸡比较一下身体比例。雏鸡的尾羽短，模型简化了绒羽。它的形态并不是成鸡的缩小版。[S22]

summary.en: Shows a mature female chicken

detail.en:
This domestic hen has a broad breast, feathered wings, a small comb and a short tail. A hen is a female chicken; a cock can also be an adult. [S9, S22]

The hen and chick share a bird's body shape, with different proportions and feathers. Singapore's roaming flocks include domestic fowl and Red Junglefowl. Use a field guide to distinguish them outdoors. [S11, S22]
detail.zh:
这只家鸡母鸡有丰满的胸部、带羽毛的翅、小鸡冠和短尾。母鸡是雌性的鸡，公鸡也可以是成鸡。[S9, S22]

母鸡和雏鸡都有鸟类的身体形态，但比例与羽毛不同。新加坡自由活动的鸡群中有家鸡和红原鸡，要在户外区分它们，可以查阅野外图鉴。[S11, S22]

summary.en: Marks the stage you choose

detail.en:
The small bead and thin ring mark the stage you choose. The control moves the marker while the animals stay in place. [S22]

Move back to look at an earlier stage again. Real animals do not grow backwards. [S15, S22]
detail.zh:
小珠和细环标出你选中的阶段。控件移动标记，动物仍留在原处。[S22]

把标记往回移，可以重新细看较早的阶段。真实动物不会倒着生长。[S15, S22]

summary.en: Marks the stage you choose

detail.en:
The small bead and thin ring mark the stage you choose. The control moves the marker while the animals stay in place. [S22]

Move back to look at an earlier stage again. Real animals do not grow backwards. [S15, S22]
detail.zh:
小珠和细环标出你选中的阶段。控件移动标记，动物仍留在原处。[S22]

把标记往回移，可以重新细看较早的阶段。真实动物不会倒着生长。[S15, S22]

summary.en: Compares the frog's changing body shapes
summary.zh: 比较青蛙身体形态的变化

detail.en:
Follow egg, tadpole, tadpole with hind legs, tailed froglet and adult. The froglet's tail stays attached as it shrinks. There is no pupa. [S2, S3]

These small shapes leave out fingers and toes. Look at the main frog tray to see four fingers on each front foot and five toes on each hind foot. The stages are enlarged separately. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
依次看卵、蝌蚪、长出后腿的蝌蚪、带尾幼蛙和成蛙。幼蛙的尾巴逐渐缩短，但仍连着身体。青蛙没有蛹期。[S2, S3]

这些小轮廓没有画指趾。要看前足四指、后足五趾的细节，可以转到主青蛙展台。各阶段分别放大。[S20, S22]

summary.en: Compares egg, chick and adult hen
summary.zh: 比较卵、雏鸡和成年母鸡

detail.en:
The row shows an egg, a downy chick and an adult hen. The chick grows as a young bird, with no pupa stage. [S6, S9]

Read from egg to adult to follow the order. Each stage is enlarged separately, so its size and spacing do not show real size or time. [S22]
detail.zh:
这一排有卵、绒羽雏鸡和成年母鸡。雏鸡作为幼鸟继续生长，没有蛹期。[S6, S9]

从卵读到成鸡，可以看出先后顺序。各阶段分别放大，模型大小和间距不表示实际大小或发育时间。[S22]

summary.en: Shows the pupa between larva and adult
summary.zh: 显示幼虫与成虫之间的蛹

detail.en:
The four shapes show egg, larva, comma-shaped pupa and six-legged adult. Larvae and pupae develop in water. The adult emerges after the pupa. [S14]

Each stage is enlarged separately. The mosquito lesson explains these water stages in more detail. [S13, S14, S22]
detail.zh:
四个轮廓依次是卵、幼虫、逗号形的蛹和六足成虫。幼虫和蛹在水中发育，成虫在蛹之后羽化。[S14]

各阶段分别放大。蚊子课文会详细介绍这些水中阶段。[S13, S14, S22]

summary.en: Compares seed, young and adult plant

detail.en:
The row shows a seed, a young plant and an adult flowering plant. A seed is different from an animal egg. [S1]

These models show broad stages, with each size set separately. The linked plant lesson explains pollination, fruit and seed dispersal. [S21, S22]
detail.zh:
这一排展示种子、幼株和开花的成株。种子与动物的卵不同。[S1]

模型把过程分成几个大阶段，大小分别设定。链接的植物课文会介绍传粉、果实和种子传播。[S21, S22]

summary.en: Marks the life cycle you choose

detail.en:
The small bead marks the life cycle you choose. The control moves it between the four groups while the specimens stay in place. [S22]

Choose another group to compare its sequence of growth and reproduction. [S15, S22]
detail.zh:
小珠标出你选中的生活史。控件让它在四组标本之间移动，标本仍留在原处。[S22]

选另一组，比较它的生长顺序和繁殖过程。[S15, S22]

summary.en: Connects adults with their offspring
summary.zh: 把成体与它们的后代相连

detail.en:
The last link shows reproduction. It connects the adult with eggs of a new generation. [S15]

The arrow stays in place to mark this connection. It shows the reading order, rather than the time reproduction takes. [S22]
detail.zh:
最后一段连接表示繁殖，把成体与下一代的卵连起来。[S15]

箭头留在原处标出这段联系，表示阅读顺序，不表示繁殖所需的时间。[S22]

summary.en: Connects adults with their offspring
summary.zh: 把成体与它们的后代相连

detail.en:
The last link shows reproduction. It connects the adult with eggs of a new generation. [S15]

The arrow stays in place to mark this connection. It shows the reading order, rather than the time reproduction takes. [S22]
detail.zh:
最后一段连接表示繁殖，把成体与下一代的卵连起来。[S15]

箭头留在原处标出这段联系，表示阅读顺序，不表示繁殖所需的时间。[S22]

summary.en: Holds the stages for comparison

detail.en: The low tray holds the stages side by side. Follow the arrows to read their order. Each animal is enlarged separately, and the gaps do not show time. [S22]
detail.zh: 低矮展台把各阶段摆在一起，方便比较。沿箭头可以看出先后顺序。各阶段分别放大，间距不表示时间。[S22]

summary.en: Holds the stages for comparison

detail.en: The low tray holds the stages side by side. Follow the arrows to read their order. Each animal is enlarged separately, and the gaps do not show time. [S22]
detail.zh: 低矮展台把各阶段摆在一起，方便比较。沿箭头可以看出先后顺序。各阶段分别放大，间距不表示时间。[S22]

summary.en: Holds four life cycles side by side

detail.en: Four groups show the life cycles of a frog, chicken, mosquito and flowering plant. Each has its own display sizes. Compare the order and shapes, rather than real size or development time. [S22]
detail.zh: 四组标本展示青蛙、鸡、蚊子和开花植物的生活史，大小分别设定。可以比较顺序和形态，不能用它们比较实际大小或发育时间。[S22]

fertilised.zh: 已受精；需要适宜的孵化条件

unfertilised.en: Unfertilised; cannot develop into a chick
unfertilised.zh: 未受精；无法发育成雏鸡
